title: The People Turn to the Creator and Reject Idols
description: On that day people will turn to their Creator and look to the Holy One of Israel, no longer to the altars, Asherah poles, and incense altars made by their own hands. The fortified cities will be abandoned like a wasteland. Because the people have forgotten their God of salvation and their rock of refuge, they plant beautiful vines and foreign shoots, but on the day of sickness the harvest will become a heap of pain that cannot be healed. [ref:Jes 17:7-11|Isaiah 17:7-11]
